finding.summary: When `--session-id` or `--resume` is the final argument with no following value, `args[$((i + 1))]` accesses an out-of-bounds index and silently sets `session` to an empty string, losing the session ID without erroring.
finding.fix: Add a bounds check before accessing the next argument, e.g. `if (( i + 1 < ${#args[@]} )); then session="${args[$((i + 1))]}"; else echo "missing value for ${args[$i]}" >&2; exit 1; fi` for both `--session-id` and `--resume`.

label: false_positive
label_reason: Raised in review and merged with the file unchanged.
